name: Sonatype
summary:
Sonatype provides software supply chain security and dependency management solutions that help organisations secure modern software development and delivery environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Sonatype technologies across secure software delivery and platform engineering environments. From dependency governance and open source security through to CI/CD integration and policy enforcement, we help teams create secure, reliable, and operationally consistent development platforms.
overview:
Sonatype technologies help organisations improve software supply chain security and governance across modern engineering environments.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Sonatype environments across cloud-native, enterprise, and platform engineering ecosystems. From dependency management and vulnerability analysis through to CI/CD integration and operational governance, we help teams create environments that support secure, scalable, and reliable software delivery practices.

Our focus is on building strong software delivery foundations that support long-term engineering quality, security, and operational consistency. This includes supply chain security, automation, lifecycle management, policy enforcement, observability, and developer enablement across complex engineering environments.

We help organisations reduce security risk, improve software governance, and deliver applications with greater confidence.
